title: Hilton’s Growth in Greece Continues with Standout Openings
summary: After introducing three brands in Greece this year, 2027 will see four new stunning hotels across Corfu, Crete and Mykonos.
body_markdown:
Listen to this article


0:00


After introducing three brands in Greece this year, 2027 will see four new stunning hotels across Corfu, Crete and Mykonos


- **Hilton’s Greek portfolio has grown from one trading hotel six years ago to more than 80 properties trading or in the pipeline, spanning nine brands and supported by its partnership with Small Luxury Hotels of the World.**
- **2026 milestones include the Greek debuts of Conrad Hotels & Resorts and LXR Hotels & Resorts, the return of Hilton Hotels & Resorts and further growth for Tapestry Collection by Hilton.**
- **Four new hotels are planned across Corfu, Crete and Mykonos by the end of 2027, expanding Hilton’s luxury, lifestyle and resort offering in Greece.**


**ATHENS, Greece** –[Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/) is accelerating its growth in Greece, expanding from just one trading hotel six years ago to more than 80 properties trading or in the pipeline today. Spanning nine brands and supported by its partnership with Small Luxury Hotels of the World (SLH), the portfolio offers travellers greater choice across Greece’s cities, islands and resort destinations.


-
-
-


ÉRA Hotel Heraklion, Tapestry Collection by Hilton Renderings - Top: Lobby Area (L) & RODOPOU & BEYOND (R), Bottom: Rooftop Pool


Hilton plans to open four additional properties across Greece by the end of 2027, bringing travellers more ways to experience the Greek islands following a year of significant brand milestones. Since the start of 2026, the company has opened[Conrad Athens The Ilisian](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/athgrci-conrad-athens-the-ilisian/) and[Sandblu Santorini, LXR Hotels & Resorts](https://www.hilton.com/en-gb/hotels/jtrblol-sandblu-santorini/) , marking the Greek debuts of the Conrad Hotels & Resorts and LXR Hotels & Resorts brands;[Hilton Chania Old Town Resort & Spa](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/chqiahi-hilton-chania/) , which marked the return of the flagship Hilton Hotels & Resorts brand to Greece; and[ÉRA Hotel Heraklion, Tapestry Collection by Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/hermhup-era-hotel-heraklion/) , further expanding Hilton’s Lifestyle portfolio in the country.


-
-


Waldorf Astoria Scarlet Bay - Main Pool Entrance (L) & Beach Pavilion (R)


Looking ahead,[Conrad Corfu](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/cfumoci-conrad-corfu/) ,[Amira Resort Crete, Curio Collection by Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/herarqq-amira-resort-crete/) ,[PHĀEA Mitato Crete, Tapestry Collection by Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/hervhup-phaea-mitato-crete/) , and[Hilton Mykonos Beach Resort & Spa](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/jmksphi-hilton-mykonos-beach-resort-and-spa/) are set to further broaden the portfolio over the next year, bringing new luxury, lifestyle and resort experiences to some of Greece’s most sought-after destinations. In the last year, Hilton has announced the signing of Waldorf Astoria Scarlet Bay and Hilton Thessaloniki, further strengthening the company’s longer-term development pipeline in Greece.


-
-


Hilton Thessaloniki - Renderings


David Kelly, senior vice president, Continental Europe, Hilton, said, “The pace of our growth in Greece has been remarkable, expanding from just one trading hotel six years ago to more than 80 properties trading or in the pipeline today. This momentum reflects both the strength of our ambitions for the country and the opportunities we see across its cities and islands. This year’s luxury brand debuts, the return of Hilton Hotels & Resorts and announcing plans to come to Thessaloniki mark important milestones for our portfolio. With more exceptional properties to come next year, we look forward to giving travellers even more ways to stay with us in Greece.”


Andreas Koukas, senior director, development, Greece and Cyprus, Hilton, said, “Our growth in Greece is underpinned by strong relationships with owners and growing demand for Hilton’s diverse portfolio of brands. From luxury resorts and distinctive collection and lifestyle hotels to our flagship Hilton Hotels & Resorts brand, we see significant opportunities to grow in both established and emerging destinations, while giving owners access to Hilton’s strong commercial engine and award-winning brands.”


### A New Chapter for Hilton Luxury in Greece


Conrad Hotels & Resorts and LXR Hotels & Resorts offer complementary expressions of luxury, each connecting guests with the character of its destination in a distinct way.


-
-


Conrad Athens The Ilisian - Top: Athenian Lounge, Bottom: Event Space (L) & Pool (R)


The opening of Conrad Athens The Ilisian marks the brand’s debut in Greece and brings Hilton back to a landmark that has been part of Athens’ story for more than six decades. First opened as Hilton Athens in 1963, the hotel helped shape the capital’s cultural and social life. Its transformation into Conrad Athens The Ilisian honours that legacy while bringing a contemporary perspective to the city, connecting guests with Athens’ architecture, art, culinary scene and enduring conversation between ancient heritage and modern life.


-
-


Sandblu Santorini, LXR Hotels & Resorts - King Superior Room (L) & Aerial View (R)


On Santorini, Sandblu Santorini, LXR Hotels & Resorts marks the brand’s Greek debut. Set on the island’s eastern coast near the foothills of Ancient Thira, the hillside retreat offers a more intimate perspective on Santorini, shaped by its volcanic landscape, Cycladic architecture and views across the Aegean.


-
-
-


Conrad Corfu - Top: Entrance (L) & Lastra Main Restaurant (R), Bottom: Premier Loft Suite Private Pool Side Sea View


Next year, Conrad Corfu will extend Hilton’s luxury presence to the Ionian Islands. Set on Corfu’s southern coast, the resort will draw on the island’s Venetian and neoclassical heritage, pairing contemporary design with curated Greek art and landscaped gardens overlooking a secluded beachfront. Its 136 rooms, suites and villas, many with private heated pools or Jacuzzis, will be complemented by three restaurants, including signature dining by Michelin-starred chef Alexandros Tsiotinis, a spa inspired by local botanicals and an open-air cinema. Just beyond the resort, guests can explore Corfu’s UNESCO-listed Old Town, historic palaces and Ionian coastline.


### Growth Across Hilton’s Curio Collection and Tapestry Collection Brands


The Curio Collection and Tapestry Collection brand portfolios, part of Hilton’s Lifestyle category, have grown in Greece from one operating hotel in 2021 to 12 as of the third quarter of 2026. The planned additions of two seasonal resorts - Amira Resort Crete, Curio Collection by Hilton, and PHĀEA Mitato Crete, Tapestry Collection by Hilton - will build on this momentum and expand the range of distinctive stays available to travellers in Crete.


-
-


Amira Resort Crete, Curio Collection by Hilton - Top: Pool, Bottom: Exterior (L) & King Superior Room (R)


Amira Resort Crete, Curio Collection by Hilton is a 214-room, adults-only beachfront resort on Crete’s northern coast, close to the historic town of Rethymno. Blending contemporary Mediterranean design with inspiration from its Cretan surroundings, the resort features stylish rooms and suites, including options with private or shared pools. Guests can enjoy three restaurants, alongside a main bar and poolside dining. The resort’s extensive wellness facilities include a spa, heated indoor pool, sauna, hammam and fully equipped fitness centre, complemented by a large outdoor pool and private beach overlooking the Aegean Sea.


-
-
-


PHĀEA Mitato Crete, Tapestry Collection by Hilton - Top: Lobby Bar (L) & Restaurant (R), Bottom: Pool Bar


Set among the rolling hills above Hersonissos, PHĀEA Mitato Crete, Tapestry Collection by Hilton offers a contemporary Cretan retreat and a more tranquil perspective on the island, conveniently located just a short drive from Heraklion International Airport. Surrounded by olive groves, fragrant gardens and mountain landscapes, the resort offers suites and a villa designed for families, couples and longer stays, alongside swimming pools, wellbeing facilities and inviting spaces for gathering and celebration. Gastronomy is deeply connected to the land, with organic gardens, and local producers bringing seasonal Cretan ingredients and traditions to the table. With direct access to the neighbouring Crete Golf Club, and opportunities to discover the island's culture, countryside and local way of life, the property invites travellers to experience a more grounded, meaningful side of Crete.


-
-


Hilton Chania Old Town Resort & Spa - Top: Celeste, Bottom: Exterior (L) & Twin Grand Deluxe Room (R)


### Continued Growth for Hilton Hotels & Resorts


Following the return of Hilton Hotels & Resorts to Greece earlier this year with the opening of Hilton Chania Old Town Resort & Spa, the flagship brand is set to expand its presence further with the upcoming opening of Hilton Mykonos Beach Resort & Spa, set to open in spring 2027.


-
-
-


Hilton Mykonos Beach Resort & Spa - Top: King Deluxe Room with Private Pool (L) & Deluxe Room (R), Bottom: Spa Pool


Set against the striking backdrop of Super Paradise Beach, the hotel will introduce a sophisticated new resort experience to one of the Mediterranean’s most iconic island destinations. Thoughtfully designed to complement its natural surroundings, the resort will unfold across elegant two-storey buildings inspired by the distinctive character of the Cyclades. The property will feature 75 beautifully appointed guest rooms and suites, each with a private veranda or balcony, while selected accommodations will offer private pools and sweeping views across the Aegean Sea. Positioned as an elevated island retreat shaped by exceptional hospitality, the hotel will offer distinctive dining experiences, thoughtfully curated wellness facilities and inviting spaces for relaxation. With its beachfront setting and effortless connection to the spirit of Mykonos, the resort will provide guests with a refined yet relaxed way to experience the island.


The additions to Hilton’s Greek portfolio form part of the company’s wider European portfolio of more than 1,300 hotels trading or in the pipeline across 19 of Hilton’s brands. This includes the recent openings of[Hilton Istanbul Airport](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/istaphi-hilton-istanbul-airport/) ,[Hotel Palacio Bellas Artes San Sebastián, Curio Collection by Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/easmtqq-hotel-palacio-bellas-artes-san-sebastian/) and[Casa Verbena Madrid, Outset Collection by Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/madamid-casa-verbena-madrid/) , and the upcoming openings of[Hampton by Hilton Lisbon City Centre Baixa](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/listshx-hampton-lisbon-city-centre-baixa/) ,[Waldhaus Flims Grand Resort & Spa, Curio Collection by Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/zrhwfqq-waldhaus-flims-grand-resort-and-spa/) and[Canopy by Hilton Warsaw](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/wawarpy-canopy-warsaw/) .


##### FAQ: Hilton’s Growth in Greece Continues with Standout Openings


Hilton plans to open four additional hotels in Greece by the end of 2027: Conrad Corfu, Amira Resort Crete, Curio Collection by Hilton, PHĀEA Mitato Crete, Tapestry Collection by Hilton, and Hilton Mykonos Beach Resort & Spa.


Conrad Hotels & Resorts and LXR Hotels & Resorts made their Greek debuts in 2026 with the openings of Conrad Athens The Ilisian and Sandblu Santorini, LXR Hotels & Resorts. Hilton Hotels & Resorts also returned to Greece with Hilton Chania Old Town Resort & Spa.


Hilton’s Greek portfolio comprises more than 80 properties trading or in the pipeline, spanning nine brands and supported by its partnership with Small Luxury Hotels of the World (SLH).


In the last year, Hilton has announced the signings of Waldorf Astoria Scarlet Bay and Hilton Thessaloniki, further strengthening its longer-term development pipeline in Greece.
